name: Google Cloud CLI
description: Installs the Google Cloud CLI (gcloud, bq, gsutil, and optional components) from Google's signed APT/DNF repositories with archive fallback, and preserves private ~/.config/gcloud state in a project volume.

version.description: Google Cloud CLI release to install ('latest' or an exact MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH version)

components.description: Comma-separated Google Cloud CLI component IDs to install alongside the base CLI
